about: Words a machine translation of a cross-reference theme title gave a MODERN meaning (extra-work/fix-cross-ref-titles.mjs). A title matching `title` is wrong when its English matches `badIf` (or always, with no `badIf`), unless its English matches `badUnless`. Patterns: `title` reads the title (Unicode), the others the English title (case-insensitive).

falseFriends.title: ក្រុមហ៊ុន
falseFriends.means: a business, for a company of people

falseFriends.title: តុលាការ
falseFriends.means: a law court, for a temple's or a king's court

falseFriends.title: បុគ្គលិក(?!លក្ខណៈ)
falseFriends.means: employees, for a shepherd's staff (not the word for personality)

falseFriends.title: យន្តហោះ
falseFriends.means: an aeroplane, for a ship's pilot
